limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

start.description: Start time for the query. Accepts Unix nanoseconds, RFC3339, or relative duration (e.g. '1h')

end.description: End time for the query. Accepts Unix nanoseconds, RFC3339, or relative duration (e.g. 'now')

since.description: Relative duration to calculate start from end (e.g. '1h', '30m'). Superseded by start if both are provided

step.description: Query resolution step width for metric queries (e.g. '5m', '1h'). Only applies to matrix (metric) responses
